safer_intro: Mementomori ry and mementomori.social follow the safer space principles. They describe what we expect from everyone on the platform and in the association’s channels, and what you can expect from us.
safer_1: Be kind and assume good intentions. You do not have to agree with everyone, and you still treat them as people.
safer_2: No racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, ableism or any other discrimination.
safer_3: No harassment. Disagreement never entitles anyone to slurs, pile-ons or hate campaigns.
safer_4: Respect boundaries. Use content warnings as the community expects, and take blocks and mutes gracefully.
safer_5: Make room. Not every conversation needs your take, and quieter voices get space here.
safer_6: Mistakes happen. When told you have hurt someone, listen, apologise and adjust.
safer_report: If you experience or witness something that breaks these principles, report it on mementomori.social or write to the moderators. Reports are handled by people, confidentially.
safer_read_more: Read more about the principles for a safer space

privacy_intro: This notice explains what personal data Mementomori ry collects on this site, why, and what rights you have. The member register is a personal data file under the EU General Data Protection Regulation.
privacy_data_register: Member register: full name, home municipality, email address, member class, billing interval, membership status, and the dates an application was made and decided.
privacy_data_optional: Optional details you choose to give: your mementomori.social account and its avatar, your Matrix user id, and your consent to appear on the member list shown to other members.
privacy_data_payment: Payments: your personal reference number, amounts, payment dates and periods, the payment method, the Stripe customer and subscription identifiers, and who recorded a manual bank transfer.
privacy_data_technical: Technical: sign-in sessions with IP address and browser user agent, sign-in link tokens, and the access token from linking a Mastodon account. Board approval decisions are recorded with the approver and their role.
privacy_basis_h: Why we process it, and on what basis
privacy_basis_register: Keeping the member register is a legal obligation: the Finnish Associations Act (yhdistyslaki 11 §) requires the full name and home municipality of every member.
privacy_basis_membership: Running the membership, collecting fees and communicating with members is based on the membership relationship itself.
privacy_basis_accounting: Payment records are kept to satisfy accounting law.
privacy_basis_consent: Appearing on the member list, and giving a Matrix user id, are based on your consent. You can withdraw either at any time.
privacy_basis_security: Session data is processed on the basis of legitimate interest, to keep accounts secure.
privacy_retention: Register data is kept while the membership lasts. Payment records and other accounting material are kept for at least six years from the end of the year in which the accounting period ended, as accounting law requires. Sessions expire on their own, and sign-in link tokens are single use.
privacy_right_access: ask what data we hold about you and get a copy of it
privacy_right_erase: have data erased, where we are not required by law to keep it
privacy_right_withdraw: withdraw consent you have given, such as appearing on the member list
